note: Behavioral detection rules for malicious LLM-provider response injection. Patterns are Go RE2 regular expressions (no lookaround/backreferences). Each match against assistant text, tool_use input, or tool_call arguments produces a Finding. v6 fixes false positives (fs-alternate-data-stream, supply-typosquat-pkg, cfg-thinking-signature), regex typos (sc.exe, .env), Windows/backslash credential paths, adds base64/reverse-shell/python-node one-liner rules, and adds native Russian description_ru for every rule.
